Privacy policy

Updated 1 November 2026

This policy covers the UberClicker website, web app and Cloud Channels. It explains what information these services handle and how to contact us about it.

Visiting the website

Our hosting provider, Cloudflare, processes web requests, including network information such as your IP address and browser details, to deliver and protect the service. The marketing website does not include advertising or analytics scripts.

To suggest a price currency, the website uses a country code supplied by Cloudflare or the region in your browser language settings. Exchange-rate requests go from your browser to Frankfurter, which receives the usual network information for that request. You can choose a different currency on the page.

Accounts and Cloud Channels

When you create an account, we store your name, email address, verification status and authentication information. Sessions can include your IP address, browser details and expiry times. Essential sign-in cookies keep you signed in; they are not advertising cookies. Sign-in and account recovery emails are sent through Cloudflare Email Service.

We store the clickers and channels linked to your account, their names and identifiers, routing choices, access credentials and connection information such as when a clicker was last seen. Cloud Channels process button actions, sender identifiers and timestamps to deliver cues to your receiving clients. Those cues do not contain your presentation slides.

Local use and installation

Local LoRa, Bluetooth and network control do not require a Cloud Channel. USB configuration and firmware installation communicate with the device through your computer after you choose to connect. Firmware downloads still make ordinary web requests. Phone and desktop apps may retain connection settings and credentials on your device so they can reconnect.

Payments

Stripe handles checkout, payment methods and subscription billing. We send your account email and account identifier to Stripe and keep customer, subscription and payment-status references to manage Cloud Channel access. Card details are entered with Stripe, rather than stored in UberClicker’s account database.

Service providers and external links

Cloudflare provides hosting, account storage, the cloud relay and account email delivery. Stripe provides payments. These providers may process information in countries other than yours. Their policies explain their own processing: Cloudflare privacy policy and Stripe privacy policy.

Downloads, source code and public issue reports are hosted on GitHub. Retailer links lead to independently operated stores. Those services have their own privacy policies. Do not include passwords, pairing codes, payment details or other private information in a public issue.

Your choices and data requests

You can sign out, unlink clickers, revoke channels and manage subscriptions in your account. Signing out or cancelling a subscription does not itself delete your account records. Account and billing information is retained to operate your account, manage subscriptions and resolve service or payment issues; some records may need to be kept to meet legal obligations.

For access, correction, deletion or other privacy questions, email info@qcecollective.com. We may ask you to verify ownership of the account before acting on a request. Depending on where you live, you may also have rights under applicable privacy law.

Changes to this policy

We will update this page when the service’s data practices change and show the revised date above.
